title: Penguin Poop Is Visible From Space and Revealed 4 Hidden Colonies

scenes.text: You can see penguin poop from space.
Emperor penguins breed on Antarctic sea ice, in places far too remote and freezing to survey easily.
But their droppings leave big brown stains on the white ice, visible to satellites.
Scientists scan the satellite images for those stains.
In 2024 they found four emperor colonies nobody knew about, bringing the known total to sixty-six.
Even in Antarctica, the poop gives you away.

description:
Emperor penguin droppings stain the Antarctic ice brown, and satellites can see them.
In 2024, scientists used the stains to find four previously unknown colonies, bringing the known total to 66.
What's the weirdest way scientists have found something?
